name: Le Barthelemy Hotel & Spa
positioning: Beachfront hotel on the crescent bay of Grand Cul-de-Sac in St. Barts, with interiors by Sybille de Margerie and Le B. Spa by Augustinus Bader
best_for: Families who want calm, shallow water right at the beach
Couples who want a suite with a private plunge pool or jacuzzi
Travelers who want a spa-focused beach stay

facts.text: The hotel is set on a crescent bay in Grand Cul-de-Sac, St. Barts, in a beachfront location.
The interiors are by designer Sybille de Margerie.
Invisible drop-down screens turn the outdoor terraces into private, shady enclaves without blocking the view.
Rooms have in-room amenities by Diptyque.
Le Barth Ocean Jacuzzi rooms have a spacious terrace with a private jacuzzi.
Some Junior Suite Ocean rooms can be connected to create a large two-bedroom suite for families.
The hotel has a serviced beach in Grand Cul de Sac with lounge chairs.
Le B. Spa has an open-air atrium that brings the outdoors in.
The Longevity Experience is led by Longevity Doctor Franck Baudino and his team, with a personalized health assessment and tailored protocol.
There is a fully equipped fitness center and group yoga classes.
Amis St. Barth is a seaside French beach restaurant serving lunch daily and brunch on Sundays.

highlights.text: Activities at the hotel's Water Sport house on Grand Cul-de-Sac Bay are included in the stay, with stand-up paddle boards, canoes and snorkeling equipment.
La Suite Ocean Piscine Privee has a sprawling patio with a heated plunge pool.
The spa is Le B. Spa by Augustinus Bader, and its Vitality Pools are three tubs: one warm tub and two cold tubs.
Le Duplex Ocean Plage spans two floors and is a private beachfront retreat a few steps from the beach.
Grand Cul de Sac is a favorite beach for families thanks to its calm waves and smooth, shallow waters.

considerations.text: Grand Cul de Sac beach is in the northeast of St Barts, 3 miles (about 5 km) from Gustavia and a short drive from the island's airport.
St Barthelemy is reached by plane or via direct links from neighboring islands; the hotel's Guest Experience Makers can help with internal flights.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects St. Barth's exclusivity.
